900001:522.characters: Examples: global feedback after scanning a QR code or NFC tag, and a confirmation dialog before leaving an unsaved report.

900001:537.name: 移动端应尽量保证文本展示的完整性，重要文本内容需换行完整展示，如有省略处理需支持下钻、展开、气泡、全局提示等交互方式进行信息补充展示； 部分长度不稳定的文本信息可设置达到最大宽度后省略或默认换行，达到最大高度后出现【展开】触发器；
900001:537.characters:
Keep mobile content complete wherever possible. Important text should wrap. If it must be truncated, provide access to the full information through a detail view, expansion, popover or message.
For content of unpredictable length, consider truncation at a maximum width or a Show more action after a maximum height.

900001:540.characters: Examples: full task names, truncated message previews, and incident notifications that expand after reaching a maximum height.

900001:561.name: 目前移动端产品已有最大信息层级为四级（一级标题、二级标题、三级标题、四级内容），其分别对应建议样式为：一级标题-小蓝标、二级标题-灰底加粗文本、三级标题-白底加粗文本、四级灰色渐变卡片内容； 如有特殊业务属性可自定义对应层级样式；
900001:561.characters:
Current mobile products use up to four information levels: a blue-marked primary heading, a bold heading on gray, a bold heading on white, and content in a subtle gray card.
Adapt this hierarchy when the business context requires it.

900001:564.characters: Examples: three information levels in plan review, and four levels with custom headings in repair feedback and measure selection.
